gloss: offense and defense, attack and defense

definitions.gloss: offense and defense, attack and defense
definitions.explanation: The back-and-forth between attacking and defending. Used in military contexts, sports, debates, and competitive situations.

examples.japanese: {激|はげ}しい{攻防|こうぼう}が{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: A fierce battle of offense and defense continued.

examples.japanese: {両|りょう}チームの{攻防|こうぼう}は{見応|みごた}えがあった。
examples.english: The back-and-forth between the two teams was exciting to watch.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}での{与野党|よやとう}の{攻防|こうぼう}が{連日|れんじつ}{報道|ほうどう}されている。
examples.english: The daily clash between the ruling and opposition parties in parliament is being reported on.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {攻|こう} (offense) and {防|ぼう} (defense). Frequently used in sports commentary to describe an exciting exchange between competing sides. Also common in political and military reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攻防|こうぼう}{戦|せん}: battle, offensive-defensive engagement
- {激|はげ}しい{攻防|こうぼう}: fierce exchange of offense and defense
- {攻防|こうぼう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる: to wage a battle of offense and defense

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with {工房|こうぼう} (workshop, studio) or {興亡|こうぼう} (rise and fall), which share the same reading.
